reviewer: Owner-authorized implementer self-review, with GPT-6 assistance; not an independent review

reviewScope.summary: PR93 private feedback candidate, including protected Preview authentication, keyboard navigation, security boundaries and bilingual privacy documentation.
evidence: Owner-reported focused Vitest: 72/72 passed across three test files.
Owner-reported ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, Vite build and git diff --check passed.
Protected Preview required same-origin credentials; the fixed client and architecture test were locally verified.
Microlearning keyboard navigation test updated and passed locally.
Nhost valid synthetic submission returned received with a receipt.
Nhost scheduled retention: 37 successful runs, daily schedule restored and synthetic expired report removed.
Final Vercel Preview submission, ordinary user-role denial and release certification remain operational checks.

adversarialFindings.description: The feedback interface is present while the server-side inbox can still be disabled.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The API fails closed unless both FEEDBACK_INTAKE_ENABLED=true and a server-only administrator secret exist. Do not activate until abuse protection and end-to-end receipt tests pass.

adversarialFindings.description: Provider firewall coverage, scheduled purge execution and actual learner-role access are not certified by source-only tests.
adversarialFindings.resolution: These are separately identified activation gates; the source merge alone must not be represented as evidence of operational readiness.

adversarialFindings.description: The public feedback form is not an appropriate destination for reporting security vulnerabilities.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The app and both documentation languages direct disclosures to the separate GitHub private vulnerability intake, rather than the feedback service.

adversarialFindings.description: Protected Vercel Preview rejected feedback requests without same-origin credentials.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Client now uses same-origin credentials. Server does not forward browser cookies to Nhost. Focused tests passed.

adversarialFindings.description: The new feedback button changed microlearning keyboard focus order.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Updated the accessibility test to verify both header controls and entry to the first session. Focused test passed.

retrospective.summary: Owner-authorized implementer self-review with GPT-6 assistance. Source corrections passed reported local checks. No independent review was performed or claimed. Production activation still requires operational verification.
